ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI compute pricing strengthens: Nebius raises selected Nvidia GPU rental rates again
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Nebius will raise pay-as-you-go prices for selected Nvidia GPUs by 17%-21% from Oct. 1, its second increase in three months; some CPU and memory instances also rise as AI compute demand remains strong.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Huawei accelerates 2027 Ascend roadmap as China demand exceeds supply
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Huawei said domestic AI-chip demand exceeds its available capacity and outlined Ascend 960DT/960PR launches in 2027 plus very-large-scale interconnect systems, intensifying competition with Nvidia in China.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI infrastructure broadens to power and networking
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Generac surged after a $2.4B Amazon data-center generator deal, while GlobalFoundries and Marvell expanded optical-connectivity capacity for AI data centers. This reinforces power and networking as key AI bottlenecks beyond GPUs.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: CoreWeave plans $3B convertible debt offering
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: The Nvidia-backed AI cloud provider launched a $3B convertible debt deal, highlighting both strong capacity demand and the rising financing intensity of AI infrastructure.

breaking_news.headline: Tech leads Wall Street rebound as oil and Treasury yields ease
breaking_news.market_impact: Nasdaq +1.69%, S&P +1.14%, SOX +3.14%; 10Y fell below 5% to about 4.946% and WTI settled at $101.91.

breaking_news.headline: US jobless claims fall to 196,000, lowest since mid-July
breaking_news.market_impact: The labor market remains resilient, reducing urgency for rapid policy easing after the Fed's first hike since 2023.

breaking_news.headline: US housing remains rate-sensitive
breaking_news.market_impact: August overall housing starts fell 2.6% and permits 2.7%; single-family starts rose 7.6%, but multifamily starts plunged 22.5% as mortgage rates approach 7%.

breaking_news.headline: Bank of England holds 3.75% but shifts more hawkish
breaking_news.market_impact: The BoE voted 6-3 to hold; three members wanted a hike to 4%, and officials warned persistent energy shocks could require tighter policy.

earnings_summary.last_24h: No new U.S. mega-cap technology earnings were verified in the cutoff window. Lennar's freshly discussed Q3 remains the key macro read-through: revenue $8.0B, GAAP EPS $1.19, gross margin 15.8%, and FY2026 delivery target cut to 80,000-81,000 amid mortgage rates near 7%.
earnings_summary.guidance_watch: The main read-through is a split economy: AI/data-center spending remains strong enough to support higher compute rental prices, while housing demand and builder margins remain pressured by high rates.

narration_points: 核心催化是折現率降溫：10年債殖利率由5%附近回落到4.946%，WTI結算101.91美元、-0.51%；油價仍破百，但邊際壓力下降。
半導體領漲：SOX 11599.5 +3.14%，AMD 545.09 +6.36%、TSM ADR 430.26 +3.00%、NVDA 219.34 +2.54%；高利率下AI硬體需求重新主導定價。
AI需求驗證不是口號：Nebius再把部分Nvidia GPU租金調高17%-21%，顯示算力供需仍緊；CoreWeave同時以30億美元可轉債籌資，反映擴建資本密集度。
競爭面看Huawei：中國AI晶片需求超過供給，2027 Ascend新晶片與大規模互連架構加快，Nvidia在中國的本土替代壓力升高。
美國基本面仍有韌性：初領失業金降到19.6萬；但房市受近7%房貸利率壓力，總體開工-2.6%、建照-2.7%，形成就業強、住房弱的分化。
台指期10月日盤收46445、+385點（+0.84%），外資淨空增2323口至-78674；最新9/18 session夜盤收47160、+701點（+1.51%）。夜盤OI官方不發布，維持null。
全球央行仍偏緊：英國央行維持3.75%但3票主張升息；市場接著看日本央行。美國今日09:15 ET公布8月工業生產與產能利用率。
120秒結論：Fed升息後市場暫時接受更緊政策，油價與10Y回落讓AI重新領漲；但真正風險仍是油價能否持續降、10Y能否守在5%下方，以及AI擴建的融資成本是否上升。
